description: Defines the abstract class 'Cell' representing a single battery cell, including its properties, limits, and behaviors such as capacity, voltage, temperature, and data storage.

classes.name: Cell
classes.description: Abstract class representing a single battery cell with properties like capacity, voltage limits, temperature, and data storage functionalities.

methods.name: Cap
methods.description: Returns the nominal capacity of the cell.

methods.name: setCapacity
methods.description: Sets the capacity of the cell.

methods.name: Vmin
methods.description: Returns the minimum voltage limit.

methods.name: VMIN
methods.description: Returns the minimum voltage limit (alias).

methods.name: VMAX
methods.description: Returns the maximum voltage limit.

methods.name: Vmax
methods.description: Returns the maximum voltage limit (alias).

methods.name: Tmax
methods.description: Returns the maximum temperature limit.

methods.name: Tmin
methods.description: Returns the minimum temperature limit.

methods.name: getVhigh
methods.description: Returns the voltage of the cell with the highest voltage.

methods.name: getVlow
methods.description: Returns the voltage of the cell with the lowest voltage.

methods.name: setSOC
methods.description: Abstract method to set the State of Charge (SOC) of the cell.

methods.name: SOC
methods.description: Abstract method to get the current SOC of the cell.

methods.name: getThotSpot
methods.description: Returns the temperature at the hottest spot in the cell.

methods.name: getNcells
methods.description: Returns the number of cells, always 1 for this class.

methods.name: checkCurrent
methods.description: Checks the current and voltage status of the cell.

methods.name: checkVoltage
methods.description: Checks the voltage status of the cell.

methods.name: thermalModel
methods.description: Calculates the thermal model of the cell based on neighboring cells.

methods.name: storeData
methods.description: Stores a data point related to the cell.

methods.name: writeData
methods.description: Writes stored data to a file with a given prefix.

methods.name: getThroughputs
methods.description: Returns throughput data for the cell.

methods.name: getVariations
methods.description: Returns variations data; marked for future deletion.
